purpose: Small descriptive comparison of local-quota and compositional thresholds across fixed redistribution directions. No expected SLO labels are assigned.
group_selection: Keep the structural contrast: the three controlled participants in the tested checkout operation versus the quota recipient outside that operation. This is not a claim of uniform service criticality or an independently optimized risk direction.
replacement_rule: No replacement, outcome-based scenario deletion, optional extension, or automatic additional waves.
allocation_semantics: The four configured CPU ceilings sum to 1 CPU; they are not reserved physical capacity. Other containers and the generator share the host. Every point starts from a fresh stack and a measured reference baseline.

analysis.kind: Exploratory in-sample threshold comparison; no calibration/test split or fitted deployment detector.
analysis.local_or: Exhaust all separate checkout/payment/shipping quota thresholds, combined with OR; each channel may also be disabled. This is an in-sample oracle baseline, not a trained detector.
analysis.comparison: Show all deterministic thresholds and the greatest number of detected unsafe points achievable at each integer false-positive budget. Budgets are display coordinates, not success criteria. Equal scores are never split by outcome.
analysis.reporting: Report every planned point, invalid reasons, all recoverable outcomes, and post-intervention failures. No causal lead-time or out-of-sample accuracy claim. A single trajectory is not executed; the redistribution paths are reconstructed from independently measured allocation points. Advertisement performance and adaptive pressure are not measured.
